Markets.title: Jefferies cuts HDFC Bank share price target but retains Buy after CEO opts out of new term. Here’s why
Markets.summary: Jefferies lowered its HDFC Bank price target from Rs 1,050 to Rs 880 after CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan decided not to seek reappointment. Despite citing near-term risks to deposits and fee income, the brokerage kept a Buy rating because current valuations are undemanding.

Markets.title: Transformers and Rectifiers shares rally 8% after receiving order worth up to  Rs 100-500 crore from MEIL
Markets.summary: Transformers and Rectifiers shares rose 8% on Monday after winning a significant order from MEIL. The contract, valued between Rs 100 crore and Rs 500 crore, involves manufacturing transformers and related work over a 35-month period.

Markets.title: Global Market: Chinese property stocks slide as new rules raise consolidation fears
Markets.summary: Beijing introduced new rules that restrict Chinese property developers from relying on homebuyer funds to curb risks from unfinished projects. Investors sold off property stocks, fearing the measures will pressure highly leveraged developers and accelerate industry consolidation.

Markets.title: India bonds slump on Fed rate hike bets, benchmark trades at discount
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds dropped on Monday as expectations of U.S. Federal Reserve rate hikes and rising oil prices pushed yields higher. These global pressures increased concerns regarding India's inflation and fiscal stability.

Markets.title: Zee Entertainment shares crash 14% amid Subhash Chandra’s 99.97% loan haircut row
Markets.summary: Zee Entertainment shares crashed 14% after the NCLT approved a debt repayment plan for founder Subhash Chandra. The plan involves recovering only about Rs 6.5 crore against Rs 22,006.57 crore in claims, resulting in a 99.97% loss for creditors.

Markets.title: Augmont Enterprises shares drop 2% after listing at 22% premium. Buy, sell or hold the stock?
Markets.summary: Augmont Enterprises shares fell 2% after debuting on the stock market at a 22% premium, which was lower than grey market expectations. Due to rich valuations, brokerages are currently divided with mixed recommendations ranging from neutral to subscribing for the long term.

Geo-Political.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
Geo-Political.summary: The United States and Iran have exchanged military strikes for the first time in weeks. Iran reported that the American attack on Larak Island killed two people and injured two others.

Geo-Political.title: Eight killed and 18 missing after ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus
Geo-Political.summary: A ferry carrying nearly 270 people capsized after leaving a port off northern Cyprus. The incident left eight people dead and 18 others missing as search and rescue operations continued.

Geo-Political.title: Iceland votes against restarting EU membership talks
Geo-Political.summary: Voters in Iceland rejected a government proposal to resume accession talks with the European Union. According to broadcaster RUV, 52.8 percent of voters voted against restarting the membership negotiations.

Geo-Political.title: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
Geo-Political.summary: A man opened fire at a techno event near Zurich, killing a 22-year-old woman and injuring five others in their twenties. Police have launched a manhunt for the shooter.

Geo-Political.title: 15 hikers feared missing after 'terrifying' flash flooding hits Grand Canyon
Geo-Political.summary: Fifteen hikers are feared missing following flash flooding in the Grand Canyon. At least one person was airlifted to safety after the sudden severe weather.

Geo-Political.title: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope
Geo-Political.summary: NASA launched a powerful new space telescope to begin a multi-year mission mapping the universe. The mission aims to help scientists learn more about dark energy and dark matter.

Data & Insights.title: Gig  work industry has dehumanized India’s workforce
Data & Insights.summary: Gig work in India has negatively impacted employee well-being by removing traditional workplace humane practices. Consequently, workers are experiencing severe, inhuman stress while trying to earn a living.

Data & Insights.title: NPCI to let users port UPI AutoPay mandates across apps
Data & Insights.summary: NPCI is introducing a feature that allows users to transfer existing UPI AutoPay mandates between different apps without canceling them. This capability also enables merchants to move their mandates to a new payment provider when switching gateways.

Data & Insights.title: Urea prices have plunged; so why is fertilizer subsidy bill under strain?
Data & Insights.summary: Even though urea prices have dropped, higher import costs for DAP and MOP fertilizers are driving up total expenses. As a result, the government's fertilizer subsidy is expected to exceed the FY27 estimate and strain the national exchequer.

Data & Insights.title: India-US trade in focus? Commerce Ministry calls exporters for September 1 meeting: Report
Data & Insights.summary: India's Commerce Ministry has scheduled a meeting with exporters and industry groups on September 1. The purpose of the meeting is to assess trade and tariff concerns between India and the United States.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi in Tashkent: India, Uzbekistan seek to unlock next phase of $1.5 billion trade ties
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Tashkent to strengthen economic ties, noting that bilateral trade currently stands at $1.5 billion. India and Uzbekistan have set a goal to double this trade volume to $3 billion within the next three years.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council sets date for first meeting since rationalisation last year
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council will hold its 57th meeting in New Delhi on September 12. This gathering follows a preparatory meeting of officials scheduled for September 11.

India.title: 3-Year-Old Tied To Chair, Slapped, Assaulted At Delhi Day Care, Shows Video
India.summary: A video shows a three-year-old child being tied to a chair, slapped, and assaulted at Makoons Play School in Northeast Delhi. Delhi Police has registered a case under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act in response to the incident.

India.title: MP's Rebel Act Part Of 'Delhi Plot' To Split Party: National Conference MLA
India.summary: A National Conference MLA has claimed that Delhi is orchestrating internal rebellion within the party. This follows Chief Minister Omar Abdullah's earlier accusation that the BJP is attempting to poach party legislators.

India.title: Over 80 Tamil Nadu Pilgrims Missing After Nepal Flash Floods, 21 Return Home
India.summary: Over 80 Tamil Nadu pilgrims remain missing following flash floods in Nepal. Meanwhile, 21 of the travelers who booked through a Kumbakonam agency have returned home safely.

India.title: GATE 2027 Registration Update: Revised Dates Soon, Documents Required
India.summary: Candidates must upload a government photo identity during GATE 2027 registration. They are also required to bring the original version of this exact ID to the exam center.

India.title: "Should Not Speak Whatever They Think": Ally Vaiko On TVK's 'Vijay For PM' Push
India.summary: MDMK chief Vaiko criticized actor-turned-politician Vijay's TVK party for pushing him as a prime ministerial candidate. Vaiko also expressed his support for Rahul Gandhi amid the ongoing political speculation.

India.title: Maharashtra CET 2026 Round 4: 23,107 Vacant Seats Released, Check Details
India.summary: The Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell has released the Round 4 vacant seat matrix, detailing 23,107 available seats for admissions. Students can now check the college-wise seat list, review the option form dates, and view the complete allotment schedule.

General.title: Prisoners freed early are returning to jail at rapid rate, governors tell BBC
General.summary: Governors told the BBC that prisoners freed early are returning to jail at a rapid rate. In response, PM Andy Burnham announced changes to the October early release scheme to ensure PC Harper's killers remain imprisoned.

General.summary: Priti Patel will be replaced by Tom Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary. This change is part of a wider frontbench reshuffle expected by Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch following high-profile departures.

General.title: Djokovic in tears during US Open first-round exit
General.summary: Novak Djokovic suffered an emotional first-round defeat at the US Open. The loss suggests that age is catching up with the 39-year-old tennis great.

General.title: This actor was told he had Alzheimer's, now he's performing a one-man show
General.summary: Actor Peter Marinker, who was previously told he had Alzheimer's disease, is performing a one-man play by Samuel Beckett on a London stage. The production showcases his return to acting despite his medical diagnosis.
